This dark-furred, green-hooded [[Ewok]] flew a [[Hang-glider/Legends|hang glider]] and dropped rocks at [[stormtrooper]]s during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. His glider was later struck by stray blaster fire from one of the troopers his rocks had hit, causing the Ewok to fall.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the website for 2015's Celebration Anaheim would later identify the actor [[Felix Silla]] as playing the [[Unidentified Ewok (hang glider) 2|lighter-furred Ewok]] seen flying a hang glider during [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in 2007 he was previously said to have played this darker-furred Ewok, whose glider was shot down by a stormtrooper's errant blaster fire.<ref name="CIVOPAGL">{{WebCite|url=http://officialpix.com/OPX/Celebrities.html|text=Celebration IV Official Pix Autograph Guest List|archivedate=20071015144459}}</ref>

On his [http://www.felixsilla.com/index.htm personal website], Silla has stated that the hang-gliding Ewok he played was to be called "Retah."<ref name="SillaRotj">{{WebCite|url=http://www.felixsilla.com/rotj.htm|text=Return of the Jedi|author=Felix Silla|work=The Worlds of Felix Silla|archivedate=20160313122842}}</ref> However, Retah has never appeared in any [[canon]] source as a name for this Ewok.
